_comment: free-tier-v2 wave: the chat popup now OPENS on the free tier and Mera explains the tier on the surface the user actually touched. 7 new keys under freeTier.chatIntro, one per chat surface, rendered as the intro pseudo-message by ChatSessionView. No collisions: freeTier.seePlans already exists in all 20 with the right label and is reused, not re-added. Input to _splice-fragments.mjs, PLUS one RETRANSLATED existing key, freeTier.chatBubble, which said "I can't build your feed" — false from this wave on, since the free tier keeps building the feed. Requires --allow-overwrite freeTier.chatBubble.
